speaker: richard_burbage
text: He's all haste. I'm seven-and-twenty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then play him at a run.

speaker: john_heminges
text: At a run, and not today. Today was a reading.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have marked the roll.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mark it, and keep it. I am not asking you anything out of it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have nothing to ask.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Nobody adds a question for him on the stair.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have been counting aloud since the second act. The number is not going away because you talked over it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Give me the number, Will.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Nine-and-twenty lines, Sweet Master Shakespeare, a fan to carry, and half a song I'm not let finish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine-and-twenty. A fan. Half a song. I heard you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Peter is a board. I will mend a board when I play him. Not in this room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You. Keep Saturday supper free, Will. I've somewhat for you that's not in this play.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Not in this play. Then I will not look for it in these twenty-three rolls. Saturday. I am keeping it. You.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The half song stays half. I will not have it finished in the yard to make a kinder number.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Half is what you wrote, and half is what I am owed. I am not finishing it here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Half is what is written. I am not adding the other half on a stair.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Seven-and-twenty, and at a run. I will not discuss the fan.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The roll is marked. I am going.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go. This afternoon is the Shrew, and you are not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am for home. Saturday is asked, and there is nothing to copy.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then bring me whatever it is when it is a thing. Until Saturday, you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Until Saturday. You.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have the haste. I have not the pages. Do not hand me a new speech at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No new speech. Play him at a run, and leave the rest.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book of account stays shut. Noon is enough.
